hook: An *Army internship* in AI and drones, with pay? Yes, in Pune

learn.t: Interns get up to Rs 30,000 a month, capped at Rs 75,000, plus 15 academic credits.

sources.name: Punekar News
sources.title: Indian Army Internship 2026: Southern Command Pune Offers Rs 75,000 Stipend, 15 Academic Credits

tldr: The Army's Southern Command in Pune is offering paid internships in AI, cybersecurity and drones from November 16.
watch: The 75-day internship runs from November 16, 2026 to January 31, 2027; apply on AICTE's National Internship Portal.
